daily_thesis: The 2026-09-16 batch says robot intelligence is becoming an authority-allocation problem. World-action and VLA papers no longer ask only whether a model can predict a plausible future; they ask whether depth, point tracks, BEV LiDAR, temporal context, object slots, or whole-body controller intents are the evidence allowed to change the next action. Geometry papers make the same move for maps: panoramic FoV, semantic place memory, LiDAR degeneracy, submap change detection, active-view benchmarks, and digital-twin structure diagnostics decide when a map update or localization estimate should be trusted. Contact-rich manipulation papers turn touch, proximity, embodiment, and geometric contracts into executable transfer conditions. Navigation, safety, and efficiency papers then supply revocation rules for episode-level uncertainty, traversability shift, rover slippage, cyber-physical attacks, body-rate-limited escape, sparse sensing, and active-parameter pruning. APRL should build evaluation assets where every representation declares what robot decision it can change and when that permission is withdrawn.

clusters.cluster: World-action models move from plausible futures to action-authority interfaces
clusters.why: 기존 world model 평가는 미래 RGB나 rollout이 그럴듯한지에 기대기 쉬웠지만, 로봇에게 중요한 것은 어떤 미래 단서가 실제 행동 권한을 갖는지다. ModAR는 RGB보다 point track, DINO feature, depth가 더 일관된 행동 단서가 될 수 있음을 보이고, WAM survey와 actionable-world-model survey는 예측을 planning, recovery, verification으로 연결해야 한다고 정리한다. WholeBodyWAM, sensVLA, GeoLAM, TEMPO, SlotDiT는 각각 whole-body controller intent, BEV LiDAR grounding, geometry teacher, temporal context, object slot이 action head에 들어가는 경로를 분리한다. APRL은 world model을 영상 생성기로 보지 말고, 어떤 modality가 action delta와 failure recovery를 허가하는지 검증해야 한다.
clusters.confidence_note: WAM survey, multi-modal WAM, VLA grounding, temporal context, latent action, and object-centric generation papers all target the prediction-to-action interface.
clusters.lab_action: LIBERO, dynamic handover, wheel-loader, and humanoid loco-manipulation tasks에서 RGB future, depth, point tracks, DINO feature, BEV LiDAR, temporal summary, object slot, and WBC intent를 ablation 축으로 두고 action delta, recovery success, latency, and contact failure를 비교한다.

frontier_memory.label: Strengthening
frontier_memory.history: September 15 framed embodied AI as permissioned evidence for action, map update, navigation commitment, and safety intervention.
frontier_memory.body: September 16 strengthens the same line: WAM modalities, geometry maps, tactile/contact states, conformal uncertainty, and compression masks all need explicit action authority.

frontier_memory.label: New signal
frontier_memory.history: Recent RI editions discussed WAMs mostly through future prediction and VLA deployment.
frontier_memory.body: Today adds modality ordering as a design axis: point tracks, depth, DINO features, BEV LiDAR, temporal summaries, and controller intents compete with RGB futures.

frontier_memory.label: Commoditizing
frontier_memory.history: 3DGS, VLA, and edge compression have appeared repeatedly in the last month.
frontier_memory.body: The differentiator is no longer using 3DGS/VLA/compression, but proving when the representation can safely change localization, contact, or action selection.

frontier_memory.label: Contradiction
frontier_memory.history: More visual information is often assumed to help embodied agents.
frontier_memory.body: ModAR questions future RGB's consistent value, TEMPO says missing temporal state matters more than scale, and AdaDE says many active VLA parameters can be removed if router evidence supports it.

frontier_memory.label: Missing axis
frontier_memory.history: The repo has separate lines for geometry, contact manipulation, navigation uncertainty, and efficient deployment.
frontier_memory.body: A shared revocation benchmark is missing: one suite should ask when evidence loses permission to update the map, continue a trajectory, compress a model, or execute contact.

strategy_board.title: Robot evidence authority benchmark
strategy_board.thesis: Create a shared benchmark where every latent, modality, map, tactile signal, and uncertainty score must declare which robot decision it can change.
strategy_board.one_week: Prototype three tasks: WAM modality ablation for manipulation, 3DGS map-update trust under dynamic change, and ENCP-style defer decisions in VLN.
strategy_board.four_week: Unify action-delta logs, map-update gates, tactile/contact ablations, and uncertainty revocation events across manipulation and navigation.
strategy_board.success: At least two representation signals predict wrong action, wrong map update, or late defer better than terminal success or reconstruction metrics.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if all authority signals reduce to model confidence or do not change intervention timing.
strategy_board.asset: Authority-labeled episodes, modality masks, action deltas, map update decisions, contact traces, and defer/recover labels.

strategy_board.title: Geometry trust and revocation protocol
strategy_board.thesis: Evaluate SLAM, 3DGS, LiDAR, active vision, and digital twins by the conditions under which their geometry should be trusted, corrected, or rejected.
strategy_board.one_week: Run a small sequence with FoV change, corridor degeneracy, dynamic object insertion, and submap change labels.
strategy_board.four_week: Compare PanoGS-style FoV conditioning, HuMem-style place retrieval, LiLi-style degeneracy, CDSD change detection, and LiDAR simulation fidelity diagnostics.
strategy_board.success: Trust gates predict localization failure, wrong loop closure, or harmful map update before downstream navigation fails.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if gates improve pose metrics but do not alter recovery or navigation decisions.
strategy_board.asset: Geometry stress scenes, degeneracy labels, submap changes, simulation-real graph diagnostics, and recovery outcomes.

strategy_board.title: Contact and embodiment transfer contract
strategy_board.thesis: Turn tactile, proximity, embodiment, constraint, and whole-body cues into explicit contracts for when human-video or language-derived skills transfer to a robot.
strategy_board.one_week: Use one dexterous task to compare point-cloud only, binary contact, proximity dynamics, and canonical embodiment cues under occlusion.
strategy_board.four_week: Add constraint-conditioned grasping, tactile teleoperation, whole-body humanoid contact, and soft-robot proprioception to the same transfer table.
strategy_board.success: Contact or embodiment contracts predict transfer failures and select better recovery actions on unseen objects or hardware.
strategy_board.stop: Stop if contact cues improve average success but fail to identify the failure mode under perturbation.
strategy_board.asset: Contact-state labels, proximity trajectories, embodiment-canonical point clouds, constraint masks, and transfer-failure taxonomy.
